profile.headline: AEM Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
My greatest motivation is to ensure that my skills, my work, and my professional relationships are always improving. To that end, I work with excellent teams to deliver quality AEM solutions for Fortune 500 companies.

I am skilled in AEM development, effective client interaction, whether the situation calls for building trust, identification and understanding of the goals of stakeholders, or managing difficult political landscapes.

I strive to create a collaborative environment where clients and internal staff are able to communicate effectively and work side-by-side to deliver the highest quality work that meets the client's unique needs.

Expertise: Adobe Experience Manager, Web Development, Client Interaction, Content Migration, Team Leadership

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Handling whatever the PTx team requires for their AEM sites and making sure to further integrate with the larger AGCO AEM ecosystem.

positions.title: Sr AEM Developer
positions.description: AEM Developer on enterprise healthcare client engagement, focusing on legacy system stabilization, production support, and technical modernization. Reverse-engineered complex AEM codebase, resolved critical production issues, and managed multi-environment deployment pipeline. Conducted technical audits and partnered with stakeholders to improve system reliability and content governance.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: In my role as a Senior Software Developer at If/Then, I take pride in delivering code that meets business requirements and best practices. I lead teams to ensure timely project delivery without compromising quality standards. Additionally, I work closely with clients on-site to understand their goals and offer guidance, contributing to a positive and collaborative work environment. My efforts have led to successful project outcomes and strengthened client relationships.
positions.insights: Visual Studio, JavaServer Pages (JSP) and +53 skills

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
I work with an interdisciplinary team of Web Developers, Designers, Project Managers, Managed Services Teams, and Technical Directors to ensure delivery of quality technical solutions that meet or exceed client expectations.

Responsibilities:
•	Deliver code in accordance with business requirements and best practices.
•	Take ownership of project deliverables and ensure that they are met in a timely and effective manner.
•	Work with clients on-site to build relationships, offer guidance, and understand client goals.
•	Assist with project planning to establish realistic timelines that will meet stakeholder goals.
•	Lead teams of developers to meet project deadlines without compromising quality standards.
•	Identify, estimate, and communicate potential risks as appropriate to avoid negative impact on project health.
•	Build and maintain relationships with clients and internal staff to maintain a positive, collaborative work environment.
•	Support for sales teams by offering technical guidance or assisting in POC development.
